rationale: The Latin anchors — particularly *reprobare* ("to reject/condemn"), *repudiare* ("to cast off"), *abjicere/dejicere* ("to cast down/away"), and the biblical phrase *oportet filium hominis reprobari* — all point to a social/moral casting-down or rejection of persons, not physical erosion of land or grading of objects. This aligns with take_down.v.02 ("reduce in worth or character"), which best captures the sense of degrading or rejecting someone in standing or esteem.
